definitions.explanation: Complete darkness or absence of light. A literary term for deep, total darkness.
A metaphorical sense referring to a period or state of evil, corruption, ignorance, or despair.

examples.japanese: {暗黒|あんこく}の{世界|せかい}が{広|ひろ}がっていた。
examples.english: A world of darkness spread before us.

examples.japanese: {洞窟|どうくつ}の{奥|おく}は{暗黒|あんこく}に{包|つつ}まれていた。
examples.english: The depths of the cave were enveloped in total darkness.

examples.japanese: {宇宙|うちゅう}の{暗黒|あんこく}{物質|ぶっしつ}は{目|め}に{見|み}えない。
examples.english: Dark matter in the universe is invisible.

examples.japanese: {暗黒|あんこく}{時代|じだい}と{呼|よ}ばれる{時期|じき}があった。
examples.english: There was a period called the Dark Ages.

examples.japanese: {組織|そしき}の{暗黒|あんこく}{面|めん}が{暴|あば}かれた。
examples.english: The dark side of the organization was exposed.

examples.japanese: {戦争|せんそう}で{国|くに}は{暗黒|あんこく}の{時代|じだい}に{突入|とつにゅう}し、{人々|ひとびと}は{希望|きぼう}を{失|うしな}った。
examples.english: The country plunged into a dark era due to war, and people lost hope.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and dramatic word. Often used as a modifier: {暗黒|あんこく}{時代|じだい} (dark age), {暗黒|あんこく}{面|めん} (dark side), {暗黒|あんこく}{物質|ぶっしつ} (dark matter). More intense and literary than {暗|くら}い or {暗闇|くらやみ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暗黒|あんこく}{時代|じだい}: dark age
- {暗黒|あんこく}{面|めん}: dark side
- {暗黒|あんこく}{物質|ぶっしつ}: dark matter
- {暗黒|あんこく}の{世界|せかい}: world of darkness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {暗闇|くらやみ}: darkness (physical, everyday)
- {闇|やみ}: darkness, gloom (versatile, common)
